newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money rates flat amid strong supply.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money rates flat amid strong supply.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates were flat amid abundant offers on Thursday and dealers said corrections were not likely before the coming week.
"If this big supply continues into next week, we can expect a decline in prices," dealer Jasenka Blagaic told Reuters.
She said mid-morning trade totalled 17 million kuna and left as much as a 100 million surplus in supply.
Call money, granted at steady 8.0 percent, accounted for most of the fresh deals and borrowers paid 8.0 percent for one-week loans.
One savings bank was charged 19 percent for a one-month borrowing.
There was no overnight trade on Wednesday as no banks reported shortfalls.
Commercial banks had 2.5 million in outstanding loans, up from Wednesday's nil, the central bank said. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385 1 4557075
